concept: Breath and voice as the instrument: contagion, deep space, quarantine, the gasp for air.

tracks.title: Vox Clausa
tracks.final: Visceral, rhythmic breathing and low-end drones claw out of claustrophobic silence, then tighten into stuttering risers and synthetic hits until the panic goes full sci-fi. Built as a strict three-act suffocation — isolated panting up front, dread in the middle, terror at the back. Cut it into the moment the air turns against the characters.

new.description: A solitary wordless vocal drifts over a low drone until a sharp intake of air ignites a ticking pulse and jagged brass hits — a biological countdown turning against the characters. Built with wide dialogue zones and sudden dynamic shifts, dropping into sparse echoes at 1:22 before accelerating into a choral climax that cuts dead at 2:34. Drop it where the infection takes hold and panic sets in. Fits: viral outbreaks, desperate final stands, sci-fi dread.
new.editor_note: A sudden cut to silence at 2:34 provides a ready-made title card gap before the final vocal tail.

old.description: For the moment a terrifying truth is revealed: a solo female voice sings a falling melody over a low drone. A sharp breath at 0:31 starts a ticking pulse, forcing a heavy brass impact at 1:06 before the melody transfers to a full choir at 2:14. The 1:22 breakdown clears space for dialogue, and an abrupt stop at 2:34 leaves a clean title-card gap. Fits: Trailer, TV Promo, Film.
old.editor_note: The 1:22 breakdown provides clear dialogue room, and the 2:34 drop to silence leaves a clean title-card gap.

tracks.title: Last Light, No Air
tracks.final: Suffocating, anxious breaths and vocal foley drift beneath massive overdriven synth swells, metallic groans and abyssal impacts — terrifying scale and crushing pressure, the human sound tiny against the void. Modular and structure-driven, built on vast negative space and isolated hits. For absolute isolation and impending destruction.

new.description: Visceral human panting and a low sub drone lock into a ticking pulse, then accelerate into a distorted bass groove and a hybrid brass climax — a mechanical countdown driven by the gasp for air. Mapped in waves for hard cutting, dropping back to isolated breathing at 1:32 before the final sprint to a ringing impact. Made for the desperate sprint to the airlock. Fits: contagion thrillers, desperate escapes, countdown dread.
new.editor_note: The 1:32 breakdown clears the grid completely, returning to isolated panting for a hard dialogue or title beat.

old.description:
For the realization of being hunted: a sub drone and rhythmic breathing seed the panic at 0:00. A ticking pulse enters at 0:28 to compound the threat, dropping into a distorted bass groove at 1:01 before the beat cuts out at 1:32. The 1:32 breakdown clears space for dialogue before strings rebuild toward a brass climax at 2:35 and a final hit at 2:54.
Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: The 1:32 breakdown drops to isolated breathing, offering a clean 23-second gap for crucial dialogue.

tracks.title: Hypoxia
tracks.final: Desperate, fading breath foley and crushing atmospheric pressure tip into a heavy, disorienting climax — oxygen deprivation and fading consciousness rendered as sound, organic choking fused with synthetic weight. Disorienting pacing built to simulate the body shutting down.

new.description: Rhythmic human breathing paces a dark sub drone, tightening into metallic synths and aggressive brass blasts — an escalation where the breath itself becomes the threat. Mapped for hard cutting, dropping into heavy impacts at 1:16 before a chaotic climax snaps back to isolated panting. Drop it where the oxygen levels hit zero. Fits: oxygen-depletion panic, claustrophobic dread, desperate escapes.
new.editor_note: The abrupt cut to silence at 2:54 leaves a clean breathing tail for title card reveals.

old.description:
For the realization that the target is being hunted: rhythmic breathing sets a tense pace over a dark drone at 0:00. A metallic synth sequence accelerates the pursuit at 0:48, compounding tension until heavy impacts and synth brass crash the foreground at the 1:16 drop. The arrangement doubles in speed at 1:49 before a hard cut at 2:54 leaves a clean title-card gap with only the breathing.
Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: Clear dialogue room holds until the 1:16 drop; the abrupt 2:54 cut leaves a clean title-card gap.

tracks.title: Proximal
tracks.final: An eerie, close-mic'd breath loop and unsettling synthetic textures hold you at unbearable proximity, then sharpen into a jagged climax — the threat is right here, inescapable, breathing on your neck. Patient and modular, built for sustained tension that finally snaps.

new.description: A metallic ticking pulse infects a low synth drone, triggering a distorted riser that slams into a heavy, aggressive bass groove — a mechanical contagion taking over the system. Mapped for hard cuts around a sudden breakdown to isolated ticking at 1:24, before stuttering edits and a wailing synth escalate into a single ringing impact. Drop it where the containment fails and the threat floods in. Fits: system breaches, sci-fi action, cybernetic threats.
new.editor_note: The sudden breakdown to an isolated ticking pulse at 1:24 provides a stark gap for title cards.

old.description: For the reveal of a mechanical threat: a high synth sits over clear air until a metallic ticking establishes a rhythm at 0:11. A distorted riser compounds the danger at 0:35, dropping into an aggressive bass groove at 0:47 that holds until a sudden breakdown isolates the ticking at 1:24. The beat returns with a fast string ostinato at 1:35, escalating into chaotic stutters before cutting hard to a final impact at 2:44. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: Clear dialogue room lasts until the 0:47 drop; the 1:24 breakdown offers a clean title-card gap.

tracks.title: Delicate Matter
tracks.final: Eerie, disembodied vocal textures and fragile low swells stretch anticipation toward collapse, with labored breath surfacing underneath — crushing, patient dread that promises something terrible. A sustained Act-1/Act-2 build for the long sequences where doom keeps approaching.

new.description: Dry, wordless gasps loop over a ticking sub drone, then get crushed by jagged synth brass and heavy impacts — the human element swallowed by mechanical panic. Three-act structure that pivots from clear dialogue room into frantic string ostinatos, dropping into a hard cut at 2:47 before a final hit buttons the silence. Drop it where the unseen threat finally breaks through. Fits: sci-fi horror, escalating disaster, sudden title cards.
new.editor_note: The hard cut at 2:47 leaves a ringing tail built for a sudden title card drop.

old.description: For the slow reveal of a terrifying truth: a wordless voice states a descending phrase over a sub drone. A low synth pulse answers at 0:34, leading to a 1:08 drop where heavy impacts and hybrid brass seize control. The rhythm accelerates through frantic strings until a sudden cut at 2:47 leaves an echoing tail, closing on the solo voice at 2:57. Clear VO room runs until 1:08; the 2:47 tail offers a title-card gap. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo.
old.editor_note: Clear VO room runs until the 1:08 drop; the 2:47 tail provides a clean title-card gap.

tracks.title: Containment Collapse
tracks.final: Struggling gasps and warning klaxons give way to explosive decompression and grinding metallic distortion — a catastrophic systems failure rendered in sound. Hard-grid disaster cue that escalates from quiet alarm to total breach. For the instant the seal fails and the air rushes out.

new.description: A metallic ticking pulse and distorted synth brass impacts accelerate into stuttering electronic hits — a mechanical suffocation that slowly chokes out the room. Three-act escalation that drops into a chaotic electronic climax at 2:01 before abruptly cutting to dead silence. Cut it into the instant the hull breaches and the oxygen vents into the void. Fits: total systems failure, explosive decompression, sci-fi disaster.
new.editor_note: The hard cut to silence at 2:38 is built for a sudden vacuum or title card reveal.

old.description: For the moment the monster is revealed: a low drone establishes the threat before a distorted synth impact drops at 0:14. A descending synth answers at 0:32, holding the frame until stuttering patterns accelerate the groove at 1:45 and an industrial beat shatters the climax at 2:01. Clear dialogue room lasts until 1:45, while the hard stop at 2:38 creates a clean title-card gap. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: Clear dialogue room holds until the 1:45 glitch pattern; the 2:38 hard stop provides a title-card gap.

tracks.title: Cryovoid
tracks.final: Dry, erratic hyperventilation and a distorted pulse build unbearable suspense, weaponizing stark drop-outs and hard vacuum cuts — sound, then sudden nothing. Advanced modular tension that simulates complete panic and oxygen deprivation. For the silence that's scarier than the noise.

new.description: Suffocating synth textures mimic a mechanical gasp before a rhythmic pulse and distorted braams accelerate into a driving rhythm — a synthetic respiration system failing in real time. The slow build leaves wide room for dialogue before the hard drop at 2:13 launches a frantic escape, terminating in a ringing decay. Cut it into the exact moment the oxygen levels hit zero. Fits: deep-space survival, critical systems failure, breathless tension.
new.editor_note: Drops hard into a fast, driving rhythm at 2:13 before cutting to a ringing decay.

old.description: For the realization of an inescapable threat: a dark texture fades in from silence. A rhythmic pulse enters at 0:15, answering the void before a distorted braam blasts at 0:35; the motif shifts to an aggressive rhythm at 2:13, compounding dread until a hard cut at 2:22 leaves a ringing decay. Clear dialogue room lasts until the 2:13 drop, setting up a title-card gap at 2:22 before the final boom at 2:30. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: Intro carries VO to 2:13; the 2:22 hard cut leaves a ringing decay for a title card.

tracks.title: Tremor
tracks.final: Sparse subterranean rumbles and metallic ticks accelerate from unsettling quiet into something hyper-kinetic and aggressively distorted — instability building to collapse. A dynamic structure that ramps from negative space to overwhelming density, simulating structural failure and rising panic.

new.description: A dark drone and metallic impacts establish a sterile quarantine zone, before rapid ticking and distorted brass blasts accelerate the panic — a mechanical suffocation that leaves no room to breathe. Three-act escalation mapped for hard cutting, shifting from eerie isolation to a heavy electronic rhythm at 1:44, before a final impact rings out. Drop it where the contagion breaches the perimeter. Fits: viral outbreak, quarantine breach, sci-fi panic.
new.editor_note: The heavy electronic rhythm drops cleanly at 1:44 to drive an aggressive third-act chase.

old.description: For the realization that they are trapped: a low texture establishes the space until a metallic impact strikes at 0:11. A solo string descends, holding the line before a ticking pulse begins at 0:54, compounding the threat until distorted brass blasts interrupt at 1:14 and a heavy rhythm pushes to a final hit at 2:23. Clear air carries dialogue to 0:54; the 1:44 drop offers a hard cut-in, and the 2:23 hit leaves a title-card gap. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: Clear air carries dialogue to 0:54, while the 2:23 hit leaves a clean title-card gap.

tracks.title: Feral
tracks.final: Primal, hyper-aggressive foley and chaotic synth overdrive lock into a fight-or-flight pulse and never let go — dense, high-tempo, no negative space, pure adrenaline. The breath here isn't fear, it's the animal taking over. Built for the chase that doesn't stop.

new.description: A suffocating sub drone and ticking percussion starve the room, while staccato strings push forward to meet heavy brass stabs — a slow asphyxiation that finally breaks. Built for hard cutting, the structure hinges on a dead-air drop at 0:58 before a full choir surges toward the final ring-out. Drop it where containment fails and the threat takes over. Fits: outbreak realization, final desperate stand, containment breach.
new.editor_note: The sudden drop at 0:58 clears the deck for a title card before the back end hits.

old.description: For the beat a high-stakes threat is revealed: a sub drone and ticking percussion establish a dark bed at 0:00. Staccato strings introduce a rising figure at 0:28, which drops to a sub boom at 0:58 before heavy percussion and brass stabs answer at 1:05. A full choir joins the climax at 1:56 until a final drum hit releases the sequence at 2:36. Fits: Trailer, TV Promo, Film
old.editor_note: The 0:58 drop provides a clean title-card gap, and the intro carries clear dialogue to 0:28.

tracks.title: Sacrilege
tracks.final: The breath concept at its most monumental — a cyclic, distorted breath loop and corrupted vocalizations swell over an oppressive drone until the whole thing detonates into colossal industrial sound design. A slow oppression that pays off in a wall-of-sound back end, built for the final beat of a dark sci-fi or horror campaign. Drop it where the threat stops hiding.

new.description: Processed, rhythmic breathing and low metallic drones set a suffocating pulse that shatters into a brutal brass impact — a mechanical contagion taking hold. Methodical escalation built for hard cuts, offering clean dialogue room before a ticking acceleration at 2:18 pushes into a driving climax and a final ringing hit. Drop it where the quarantine fails and the frantic escape begins. Fits: frantic escapes, hidden threats, sci-fi horror.
new.editor_note: The brutal brass impact at 0:48 provides a hard cut to black or a title card reveal.

old.description:
For the beat a hidden threat emerges: metallic textures settle over a low drone, and processed breathing starts a steady pulse at 0:11. A descending synth motif answers at 0:24, holding tension until a heavy brass blast cuts the bed at 0:48; the figure returns at 1:38, accelerating into fast ticking at 2:18 before a final strike rings out at 3:03. The front end carries dialogue to 2:18, and the 0:48 drop opens a title-card gap.
Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: The 0:48 brass blast opens a clean title-card gap, and the front end carries dialogue to 2:18.

tracks.title: Unleashed
tracks.final: Raw, panicked hyperventilation and chaotic, hyper-kinetic sound design hit at maximum intensity — tension built not from anticipation but from sheer frantic breath, a fight-or-flight response under crushing pressure. Dense and high-BPM, chaotic impact over slow build. For the panic that explodes instead of creeping.

new.description: A low drone and sparse metallic textures simulate the cold isolation of quarantine, ticking into aggressive risers before detonating into heavy beats and blaring synth brass — a catastrophic systems breach. Structured for a slow realization of doom, it offers clear dialogue room before the hard drop at 2:00, snapping to a ringing metallic tail. Drop it where the airlock fails and the threat rushes in. Fits: deep-space isolation, quarantine breach, sudden ambush.
new.editor_note: The hard drop at 2:00 pivots the scene from creeping isolation to violent action.

old.description: For the reveal of a terrifying entity: a low synthetic drone holds the floor beneath metallic textures. A high tone answers at 0:32, and rhythmic pulses drive the momentum from 1:04 until aggressive textures accelerate into a 2:00 beat drop. Clear dialogue room lasts until 1:35, and the abrupt 2:45 cut leaves a ringing metallic tail for a title card. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo
old.editor_note: Clear VO room runs to 1:35; the 2:00 beat drop hits hard before an abrupt 2:45 cut.

tracks.title: Splintered Nerve
tracks.final: The breath fractures into sharp, involuntary gasps amid grinding industrial sound design — jagged, hyper-tense, a nervous system overloading. Modular tension that lurches from sparse gasping foley into technological breakdown. For neurological dread and systems coming apart.

new.description: A mechanical tick infects a sparse piano motif, then triggers heavy trailer impacts and jagged synth brass — a clinical countdown to total system failure. The gasp for air here isn't breath, it's the sudden breakdown at 2:04 that drops the driving beat for ticking tension. Built for hard cutting, ending on a final impact and piano ring-out. Drop it where the perimeter breaches and the clock starts. Fits: high-stakes countdowns, villain reveals, system failure.
new.editor_note: Breakdown at 2:04 provides a clean exit from the heavy beat, leaving ticking tension.

old.description: For the moment the villain's master plan is revealed: a ticking pulse establishes a bed, and a falling piano motif answers it over a low drone. A distorted riser seeds the escalation at 0:24, pushing toward a 1:28 drop where heavy percussion and synth brass release the pressure. The 2:04 breakdown opens a clean dialogue window before the final 3:05 hit rings out, leaving the piano alone. Fits: Trailer, TV Promo, Sizzle Reel.
old.editor_note: Clear dialogue room runs to the 1:28 drop; the 2:04 breakdown provides a clean exit point.
